issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Web layer's PersonResource to “implement a default no-args constructor”. However, both the template and the solution use constructor-based dependency injection (a single-arg constructor PersonResource(PersonService)), and no default no-args constructor is present. This is a structural contradiction: students reading the problem may attempt to add a no-args constructor (or be confused why the provided controller lacks it), which is unnecessary for the provided template and could confuse them about the intended DI pattern.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove or reword the requirement in the problem statement that PersonResource must implement a default no-args constructor. Instead, describe the intended approach (e.g., constructor-based dependency injection is used in the template) or indicate that a no-args constructor is not required. If the intent was to require a no-args constructor, update the template and solution to include a no-args constructor without breaking dependency injection (or explain the expected injection approach).
